panels.title: Total tokens
panels.description: Total tokens in the selected period. Respects $machine/$agent/$model.

panels.title: Agent turns
panels.description: How many times the agent replied (assistant turns).

panels.title: Human turns

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'human') AS v FROM agents.usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[]);

panels.description: How many prompts YOU sent interactively. Collectors already leave out subagents, `codex exec` and scheduled automation.

panels.title: Cache-read share

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100.0 * sum(cache_read_tokens) / nullif(sum(cache_read_tokens + input_tokens), 0) AS "Cache-read share"
FROM agents.usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND coalesce(model,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[]);

panels.description: Share of prompt tokens served from cache. Here the color IS meaningful (a low share is genuinely worse), so the ratio keeps its red/yellow/green scale.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', ts, current_setting('TimeZone')) AS time, agent AS metric, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens
FROM agents.usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND coalesce(model,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1, agent ORDER BY time ASC, metric ASC;

SELECT time_bucket('1 day', ts, current_setting('TimeZone')) AS time, coalesce(model,'unknown') AS metric, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens
FROM agents.usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND coalesce(model,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1, coalesce(model,'unknown') ORDER BY time ASC, metric ASC;

panels.title: Token-type split /day (raw)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', ts, current_setting('TimeZone')) AS time, t.kind AS metric, sum(t.val) AS tokens
FROM agents.usage_event e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  ('input', e.input_tokens), ('output_excl_reasoning', e.output_tokens - coalesce(e.reasoning_tokens, 0)),
  ('cache_read', e.cache_read_tokens), ('cache_write', e.cache_write_tokens),
  ('reasoning', coalesce(e.reasoning_tokens, 0))) AS t(kind, val)
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND coalesce(model,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1, t.kind ORDER BY time ASC, metric ASC;

panels.description: Raw usage_event. Reasoning is a subset of output, so output is shown excluding reasoning and the stacked slices sum to the true total. Follows the time picker (raw rows are kept for good).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', ts, current_setting('TimeZone')) AS time, agent AS metric, count(*) AS turns
FROM agents.usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'agent' AND machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND coalesce(model,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1, agent ORDER BY time ASC, metric ASC;

SELECT coalesce(model,'unknown') AS metric, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens
FROM agents.usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND coalesce(model,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT machine AS "Machine", sum(total_tokens) AS "Tokens", sum(turns) AS "Turns",
       round(100.0 * sum(cache_read_tokens) / nullif(sum(cache_read_tokens + input_tokens), 0), 1) AS "Cache %",
       round(100.0 * sum(total_tokens) / sum(sum(total_tokens)) OVER (), 1) AS "Share %"
FROM agents.usage_daily WHERE kind = 'agent' AND machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND coalesce(model,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[]) GROUP BY machine ORDER BY "Tokens" DESC;

SELECT agent AS "Agent", coalesce(model,'unknown') AS "Model", sum(total_tokens) AS "Tokens",
       sum(turns) AS "Turns",
       round(100.0 * sum(cache_read_tokens) / nullif(sum(cache_read_tokens + input_tokens), 0), 1) AS "Cache %"
FROM agents.usage_daily WHERE kind = 'agent' AND machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND coalesce(model,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[]) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY "Tokens" DESC;

panels.title: Agent activity (weekday x hour)

targets.rawSql:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT extract(hour FROM ts)::int AS hour, extract(isodow FROM ts)::int AS dow, total_tokens AS tokens
  FROM agents.usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'agent' AND machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND coalesce(model,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[]))
SELECT g.hour AS "Hour",
  coalesce(sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE dow=1),0) AS "Mon",
  coalesce(sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE dow=2),0) AS "Tue",
  coalesce(sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE dow=3),0) AS "Wed",
  coalesce(sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE dow=4),0) AS "Thu",
  coalesce(sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE dow=5),0) AS "Fri",
  coalesce(sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE dow=6),0) AS "Sat",
  coalesce(sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE dow=7),0) AS "Sun"
FROM generate_series(0,23) AS g(hour) LEFT JOIN e ON e.hour = g.hour
GROUP BY g.hour ORDER BY g.hour;

panels.description: Agent token volume by hour-of-day (x) and weekday (y). Darker = more (exponential colour scale - the data is very skewed, so a linear scale would look near-binary). Typical-week rhythm: the whole range is folded into a fixed 7x24 grid, so the axes stay put - only intensities move. Raw usage_event; follows the picker.

panels.title: When I prompt (weekday x hour)

targets.rawSql:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT extract(hour FROM ts)::int AS hour, extract(isodow FROM ts)::int AS dow
  FROM agents.usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'human' AND machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[]))
SELECT g.hour AS "Hour",
  coalesce(count(e.hour) FILTER (WHERE dow=1),0) AS "Mon",
  coalesce(count(e.hour) FILTER (WHERE dow=2),0) AS "Tue",
  coalesce(count(e.hour) FILTER (WHERE dow=3),0) AS "Wed",
  coalesce(count(e.hour) FILTER (WHERE dow=4),0) AS "Thu",
  coalesce(count(e.hour) FILTER (WHERE dow=5),0) AS "Fri",
  coalesce(count(e.hour) FILTER (WHERE dow=6),0) AS "Sat",
  coalesce(count(e.hour) FILTER (WHERE dow=7),0) AS "Sun"
FROM generate_series(0,23) AS g(hour) LEFT JOIN e ON e.hour = g.hour
GROUP BY g.hour ORDER BY g.hour;

panels.description: Your INTERACTIVE prompts by hour-of-day (x) and weekday (y). Darker = more. Hours and days are in the sink time zone (AUT_TZ). Tooltip: top number = hour, Value = prompt count, Name = weekday.

panels.title: Top projects

targets.rawSql:
WITH n AS (
  SELECT nullif(regexp_replace(coalesce(project,'(none)'), '^-+|-+$', '', 'g'), '') AS proj,
         agent, total_tokens, cache_read_tokens, input_tokens, ts
  FROM agents.usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'agent' AND machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
AND coalesce(model,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[]))
SELECT coalesce(proj,'(none)') AS "Project",
       string_agg(DISTINCT agent, ', ' ORDER BY agent) AS "Agents",
       sum(total_tokens) AS "Tokens",
       count(*) AS "Turns",
       round(100.0 * sum(cache_read_tokens) / nullif(sum(cache_read_tokens + input_tokens), 0), 1) AS "Cache %",
       max(ts)::date AS "Last active"
FROM n GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "Tokens" DESC LIMIT 20;

panels.description: Raw usage_event, follows the time picker. 'Agents' = which tools worked this project.

options.content: **Range-following** panels (KPIs, tokens/turns by agent/model, Top-10 models, Token-type split, Weekday x hour, Top projects) read raw `usage_event` (kept for good) so any window - including 'Last 24 hours' - is exact and always current. The **Lifetime** tables read the `usage_daily` rollup (all-time, ignores the picker). **API-equivalent USD** applies current catalog rates to the measured components in the selected range. Use the pricing coverage panels to see the share of tokens with rates and the known cost. Estimated total is blank when any tokens are unpriced. Logged cost comes from the source record. Refresh the catalog with `aut sync-prices --sink`. `cursor` (IDE) has no per-message model (`unknown`) and no cache attribution -- a lower bound; the accurate Cursor path is its usage API (opt-in).

panels.title: Known API-equivalent USD
panels.description: Sum of measured components with rates. Price coverage shows how much usage this represents.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(known_api_cost_usd) AS "Known USD"
FROM agents.usage_price u
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND u.machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND u.agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND coalesce(u.model, 'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[])

panels.title: Priced token share
panels.description: Tokens with a usable component rate divided by measured billable tokens, including unattributed tokens.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(priced_tokens) / nullif(sum(coverage_tokens), 0) AS "Priced share"
FROM agents.usage_price u
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND u.machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND u.agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND coalesce(u.model, 'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[])

panels.title: Unpriced tokens
panels.description: Tokens missing a component rate or a billable component breakdown.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(unpriced_tokens) AS "Unpriced tokens"
FROM agents.usage_price u
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND u.machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND u.agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND coalesce(u.model, 'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[])

panels.title: Known API-equivalent USD per month

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', ts) AS "time", u.agent AS metric,
       sum(known_api_cost_usd) AS "Known USD"
FROM agents.usage_price u
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND u.machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND u.agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND coalesce(u.model, 'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1, u.agent
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Sum of measured components with rates by agent. See the coverage panels for the selected range.

panels.title: Pricing by model

targets.rawSql:
SELECT u.model AS "model", count(*) AS "Events",
       sum(coverage_tokens) AS "Coverage tokens",
       sum(priced_tokens) AS "Priced tokens",
       sum(unpriced_tokens) AS "Unpriced tokens",
       sum(known_api_cost_usd) AS "Known USD",
       CASE WHEN count(estimated_api_cost_usd) = count(*) THEN sum(estimated_api_cost_usd) END AS "Estimated total USD",
       sum(logged_cost_usd) AS "Known logged USD",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE logged_cost_usd IS NULL) AS "Events missing logged cost",
       extract(epoch FROM now() - min(rate_synced_at)) AS "Oldest rate age"
FROM agents.usage_price u
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND u.machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND u.agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND coalesce(u.model, 'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "Coverage tokens" DESC

panels.description: Measured tokens with and without a rate, the known API-equivalent cost, and the subtotal of logged costs present in the source records. Estimated total requires fully priced usage. Rate age is the oldest matched rate.

panels.title: Pricing by agent

targets.rawSql:
SELECT u.agent AS "agent", count(*) AS "Events",
       sum(coverage_tokens) AS "Coverage tokens",
       sum(priced_tokens) AS "Priced tokens",
       sum(unpriced_tokens) AS "Unpriced tokens",
       sum(known_api_cost_usd) AS "Known USD",
       CASE WHEN count(estimated_api_cost_usd) = count(*) THEN sum(estimated_api_cost_usd) END AS "Estimated total USD",
       sum(logged_cost_usd) AS "Known logged USD",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE logged_cost_usd IS NULL) AS "Events missing logged cost",
       extract(epoch FROM now() - min(rate_synced_at)) AS "Oldest rate age"
FROM agents.usage_price u
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND u.machine = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND u.agent = ANY(ARRAY[${agent:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND coalesce(u.model, 'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${model:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "Coverage tokens" DESC

panels.description: Measured tokens with and without a rate, the known API-equivalent cost, and the subtotal of logged costs present in the source records. Estimated total requires fully priced usage. Rate age is the oldest matched rate.
